cases.name: changed original body or packet digest
cases.change: original_upgrade_cid or original_upgrade_packet_sha256 differs from independently authenticated old row
cases.expected: CustodyLost; no append. ChangedIntent applies only after the retained original is fully authentic.

cases.name: missing or altered prior full manifest
cases.change: prior_runtime_wire does not hash to saved old pair.current_manifest_sha256
cases.expected: CustodyLost for saved altered/missing linked dependency; UnsupportedPreparation for unavailable pre-append trusted acquisition. No recapture.

cases.name: different old correspondence
cases.change: prior_pair_sha256 differs from exact authenticated field12
cases.expected: CustodyLost for forged saved pair binding; ChangedIntent only for a fully valid original with a different retained intent.

cases.name: unknown predecessor/profile
cases.expected: UnsupportedPreparation; no new enum or generalized compatibility.

cases.name: physical package or library/ABI/license/closure/asset mismatch
cases.change: opaque whole-package witness or finite compatibility fails
cases.expected: CustodyLost for changed bound physical generations/bytes; UnsupportedPreparation for a non-admitted profile. No metadata-only Allow.

cases.name: caller proof or Boolean only
cases.expected: No callable public factory; private acquisition without trusted capability returns UnsupportedPreparation.

cases.name: current permission revoked before or after callback
cases.change: current run:submit/publish/read or same scope check denies
cases.expected: AuthorizationDenied at its current fence; no receipt or disclosure. Uncertain committed outcome stays Unknown until same lookup.

cases.name: same operation different intent
cases.change: operation_id reused with different target, original or current identity

cases.name: other operation after the one finite successor
cases.change: another operation requests replacement of closed runtime-successor/0.1 row

cases.name: wrong role or duplicate/unknown record field
cases.change: body under policy-upgrade key or unselected role

cases.name: old deadline/read selection mutation
cases.change: new proposal attempts old Policy/Run/grant date change
cases.expected: Closed record rejects unknown fields; CustodyLost on restore. A valid saved intent mismatch returns ChangedIntent.

cases.name: acknowledgement lost
cases.change: record+counter may have committed; caller did not receive reply
cases.expected: Unknown then same original operation lookup only; no new attempt/append/HMAC reissue
